name: Quince Brandy

ingredients.name: fresh quince at peak of ripeness

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry quince and either grate or finely chop. Fill 2 quart-size canning jars approximately 3/4 full of quince, add spices, and top with cognac. Seal and keep in a cool, dark place until well matured, a minimum of 6 weeks, or up to 1 year (or more?). Strain before using, passing the liquid through a fine mesh strainer and then a coffee filter to remove small particles. Enjoy.

schema_metadata.keywords: brandy, cocktails, holiday recipes, quince, winter drinks

description: The heady perfume and brisk tartness of quince are perfectly complemented by a fruity cognac, and a combination of the flavors can result in absolutely phenomenal sidecars.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 42 days 5 min.

Optional or for serving: 3 to 4 whole cloves (optional); 1 cinnamon stick (optional)
author: Paul Clarke
